```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Bash chunks are a record of commands you ran in the Terminal. Knitting shows
```


Assembly of the BBD nanopore reads with Flye. Commands for this step were run in `flye/`.

Change directory into `flye` and then make a symbolic link to the bbd read data

```{bash}
cd ~/bbd-metagenome/flye # Change directonary
ln -s /pvol/data/metagenome_assembly/bbd_0.1.fastq.gz . #symbolick link 
```

create a new shell script:

name: run_flye_bbd.shg

ssave it in flye

```{bash}
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --time=720
#SBATCH --ntasks=12 --mem=20gb

echo "Starting flye bbd in $(pwd) at $(date)"

flye --nano-hq bbd_0.1.fastq.gz --threads 12 --out-dir bbd --meta

echo "Finished flye bbd in $(pwd) at $(date)"
```

And submit the job:

```{bash}
sbatch run_flye_bbd.sh
```

follow the queue

```{bash}
squeue
```
